title: 🎉 Big News! Graphiti is Launching on Product Hunt
summary: Graphiti to launch on Product Hunt this Wednesday, February 19th!
body_markdown:
Hey Zep Community,


We're excited to share that Graphiti, Zep’s open-source Temporal Knowledge Graph library, will be launching on Product Hunt this **Wednesday, February 19th** !


[Follow Graphiti on Product Hunt!](https://www.producthunt.com/products/graphiti)


🎯[Graphiti](https://github.com/getzep/graphiti) emerged from our work on Zep's memory layer, where we needed a better way to help AI agents maintain and reason about evolving information. We developed a knowledge graph builder that not only understands relationships between entities but also how they change over time.


What makes Graphiti unique:


- Temporal awareness that tracks how facts and relationships evolve
- Built-in support for both unstructured text and structured JSON data
- Hybrid search combining semantic similarity and graph algorithms
- Designed specifically for AI agent applications


We'd appreciate your support on Wednesday by:


1. Checking out[Graphiti](https://www.producthunt.com/products/graphiti) on Product Hunt
2. [Sharing your thoughts](https://www.producthunt.com/posts/graphiti-graph-memory-for-ai-agents) on temporal knowledge graphs and AI agent memory
3. Helping spread the word to developers who might find it useful
4. Engaging with our[GitHub repo](https://github.com/getzep/graphiti) (star, fork, or contribute)


Best,


Daniel and the Zep Team


Written by


**[Daniel Chalef](https://www.getzep.com/blog/author/daniel/)** Founder and CEO, Zep
